title: Parse key=value pairs
spec: Parse 'key=value' pairs separated by ';' into a dict of strings. Whitespace around keys and values is stripped. Segments without '=' are ignored. Empty input returns {}.

candidates.summary: Broken at import time: references an undefined name (exercises execution-error handling).
